text: Which AI automation consultants in Sydney specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

sections.text:
For a Sydney mid-market business seeking **Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical workflow automation**, the strongest apparent matches are:

| Consultant | Why consider them | Best fit |
|---|---|---|
| **365 Digital Consulting** | Sydney-based Microsoft 365 and Copilot consultancy specialising in Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Power Platform, workflow automation, and business systems integration.[1] | SMEs and growing organisations already using Microsoft 365, especially professional services, construction, education and not-for-profits |
| **CG TECH** | Works with Sydney businesses of roughly 50–500 staff, combining Microsoft 365, Copilot, Power Platform, custom AI agents, governance and process automation.[2] | Mid-market companies wanting practical automation rather than experimental AI projects |
| **Eagle360 Consulting** | Sydney-based Microsoft Solutions Partner building production Power Apps, Power Automate and Copilot Studio agents, including Business Central integrations through custom MCP servers.[7] | Microsoft-heavy organisations using Dynamics 365 Business Central |
| **Team 400** | Focuses on mid-market companies with 50–500 employees and offers Microsoft AI consulting, Copilot Studio agents, custom AI agents and workflow automation.[5][9] | Businesses needing custom software engineering alongside AI implementation |
| **Synenza** | Designs Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Dynamics 365 and Azure AI agents connected to business data, Power Automate, Dataverse and Power Apps.[6] | Organisations needing secure, integrated internal, customer-service or operational agents |
| **Workforce Agents** | Combines Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry with Power Platform, n8n, Zapier, Make and other workflow tools, selecting the stack around the business problem.[3] | Businesses wanting vendor-neutral workflow automation across multiple platforms |
| **AI First Partners** | Sydney-based consultancy offering AI readiness, Copilot Studio, Azure Foundry, custom agents, integrations and practical automation for industries including construction, healthcare, manufacturing and professional services.[8] | SMB and mid-market teams seeking hands-on adoption, training and measurable workflow improvements |
| **TACMinds** | Implements Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Logic Apps and AI Builder, with an emphasis on production deployment and agent architecture.[10] | Larger or more technically complex organisations requiring enterprise-grade controls |

### Shortlist by likely need

- **Best overall Microsoft 365/Copilot fit:** 365 Digital Consulting or CG TECH.
- **Best for Business Central:** Eagle360 Consulting.
- **Best for custom engineering and 50–500 employee businesses:** Team 400.
- **Best for secure enterprise agents and Dynamics integration:** Synenza.
- **Best for mixed-tool, vendor-neutral automation:** Workforce Agents.
- **Best for practical adoption and training:** AI First Partners.
- **Best for complex Azure-based implementations:** TACMinds.

When comparing proposals, ask each firm to show a comparable production deployment, explain how agents will access and update business data, identify human approval points, and provide governance, monitoring, security and handover—not just a chatbot demonstration.
